description:
The Easy Transit Fat Tire Folding Mobility E‑Trike

The Easy Transit Fat Tire Folding Mobility E‑Trike redefines independence and comfort for seniors and mobility-conscious riders. Designed with stability, portability, and safety in mind, this electric mobility tricycle offers the perfect balance of power and convenience. Its compact 16” x 4” wide fat tires and sturdy folding frame make it simple to store, transport, and ride—whether you’re running errands, visiting friends, or exploring the outdoors.

The extra-wide fat tires create a stable, cushioned ride on various surfaces, helping seniors and mobility users maintain better balance and control. The 13Ah battery provides dependable power for up to 50 miles per charge, while the 750W rear-mounted motor ensures smooth acceleration and steady power for hills or longer rides. Choose between pedal-assist for exercise and engagement or let the full-electric throttle mode take care of the work entirely.

This lightweight yet powerful mobility trike for adults folds neatly in half—along with the handlebars—allowing easy storage in a vehicle or garage. Equipped with both front and rear baskets (including a latching rear basket for secure storage), the Easy Transit is perfect for carrying groceries, personal items, or mobility equipment. Adjustable handlebars and ergonomic grips keep your posture upright and relaxed, reducing strain on the back, shoulders, and knees, while ensuring full control and confidence on every ride.

Combining stability, comfort, and accessibility, the Easy Transit E‑Trike empowers seniors and mobility riders to enjoy active, independent lifestyles with ease.

750‑Watt Motor Options:

Functions in pedal-assist or full-electric mode. Top speed of 16 mph in full-electric mode and 28 mph in pedal-assist mode for versatile riding options.

Long-Range Battery:

The 13Ah battery provides between 18 to 40 miles of range in full-electric mode and 20 to 60 miles in pedal-assist mode, ideal for day trips or errands around town.

Stable Fat Tire Design:

16-inch wheels with 4" wide knobby tires deliver superior traction and balance, offering a smooth, stable, and secure ride for those with limited mobility or balance concerns.

Responsive Braking System:

Front and rear mechanical disc brakes ensure quick, controlled stopping power for enhanced safety on inclines or busy streets.

Ergonomic Comfort Frame:

The ultra‑comfortable ergonomic design promotes an upright, relaxed posture, reducing pressure on joints and muscles. Fits riders from 4’11” to 6’5”. Comes with a rear folding basket for added convenience.

Battery Compliant to the UL 2271 Standard as Tested by ACT Lab
